description: Completeness at the noise cap (pq-zether.md 4.3, 14; P6e D9): K_MAX - 1 = 65,535 proven-norm credits to a known receiver key, aligned to maximise the decryption noise in coefficient 0, plus the plain unit, summed into T; the receiver's debit R_TX over T proves and verifies in PQZL (PQZH not in this set's build). Stored as seeds, per-credit ctHash and the aggregate (not 65,535 ciphertexts). bound: the worst case the verifier accepts (attacker-registered key at the norm bounds, T noise 65,535 * B_FRESH, the plain unit has noise 0); illustrative: an honest key. Margins against the proven range 2^30 and the mint threshold Delta - 2^30 (pq-zether.md 4.3).

bound.note: The worst case the verifier accepts: a receiver key at the norm bounds (s = 42 at one coefficient outside poly 0, whose |coefficients| <= 1 R_REG's approximate l_inf filler proves; e = 189 at one coefficient), registered (its R_REG proves and verifies in PQZL (PQZH not in this set's build)), every credit at noise B_FRESH = 189*42 + 42*189 + 64 in coefficient 0 (r = 42 along rot(e), e1 = -189 against rot(s), e2_t = (64, 0, ...)), each credit the same ciphertext (the maximum is unique), proved by its sender's R_TX (credit 0 and the last shown, PQZL (PQZH not in this set's build)), plus the plain unit (noise 0): T noise = 65,535 * 15,940 = 1,044,627,900.

illustrative.note: Illustrative: an honest receiver key (KeyGen), credits aligned to it; below the bound case.
illustrative.alignment: Noise of a credit in coefficient 0 = <rot(e), r> - <rot(s), e1> + e2[0] for the receiver key (s, e), rot(x) per poly = (x_0, -x_63, ..., -x_1). r: the same for every credit, greedy max of <rot(e), r> with ||r||^2 <= 1764 over integer increments (k, a) (gain |w_k|, cost 2a + 1) by gain / cost descending, ties by (k, a). e1 of credit k: every coordinate with rot(s) != 0 at level L (largest with L^2 N <= 35721), X = (35721 - L^2 N) / (2L + 1) of them at L + 1, the X first by (prio, index), prio_i = be32 of SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-WORSTCASE-V1 || generator_seed || be4(k)) bytes 4i..4i+4, sign -sign(rot(s)). e2 = (64, 0, ..., 0). Message digits(credit_value). Credits by pqz_encrypt (C), T = sum of the credits + Trivial(digits(plain_used)) mod q.
